meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你配置、运行和分析流体动力学模拟，包括2D/3D Navier-Stokes、浅水方程、分层流等。它提供参数设置、模拟执行、输出分析和可视化功能。
howto.when: 当你想运行流体动力学模拟（如湍流、涡旋动力学、地球物理流），或需要配置求解器、检查参数、分析输出时，可以请求帮助。

say.text: 从模拟目录加载之前的结果，并画出涡量场。
say.note: 使用 load_sim_for_plot 加载并绘图。

say.text: 用MPI在8核上运行3D Navier-Stokes模拟，分辨率128^3。
say.note: Claude 会指导mpirun命令和参数配置。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can help you configure, run, and analyze computational fluid dynamics simulations, including 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow-water, and stratified flows. It provides parameter setup, execution, output analysis, and visualization.
howto.when_en: When you need to run fluid dynamics simulations (e.g., turbulence, vortex dynamics, geophysical flows), or need help configuring the solver, checking parameters, or analyzing outputs.

say_en.text: Load a previous simulation from directory and plot vorticity field.
say_en.note: Uses load_sim_for_plot to load and plot.

say_en.text: Run a 3D Navier-Stokes simulation on 8 MPI cores with 128^3 resolution.
say_en.note: Claude will guide mpirun command and parameters.
